name: prodscope
description: Operational-first coding plugin: Builder-Breaker loop with SRE review, HEALTH_CHECK enforcement, reliability scoring, and telemetry hooks.

interface.shortDescription: Builder-Breaker loop with SRE review for every code change
interface.longDescription: Prodscope adds a structured Builder-Breaker loop to your coding workflow. A Builder proposes the smallest coherent diff with a HEALTH_CHECK, then a Breaker reviews it with senior SRE skepticism. Changes are scored 1-10 on reliability before they land.
defaultPrompt: Use Prodscope to build a feature with production-grade review.
Use Prodscope to review this change for production risks.
